reviews.text:
Don’t believe the ratings!. We moved over to FreshBooks a long time ago to escape QuickBooks. 

Back then FreshBooks was much more proactive in addressing and solving the problems for users just like us. At some point in the last few years, they stopped putting effort in. The app never gets a meaningful update, and it has major bugs that are just plain unacceptable. 

Examples: 
1) Our old logo from 3 years ago perpetually keeps getting forced inplace for all forms (invoices!). Every time. Just now, I converted an estimate (which already had our new logo on it) to an invoice, and FreshBooks put our old logo on the header. The old logo doesn’t even exist on my device, so the app is actively removing the correct logo and swapping the bad one back in.

They do not handle edge data properly at all. Another example is when I 100% have a working connection, the app doesn’t ever sync correctly. Some invoices (that I’m trying to add payments to) show all zeros. Some don’t ever show up, and some apply a payment twice for no reason at all.

So I can’t trust the app (this happens probably 20 to 35% overall!) when trying to do simple transactions for my customers, and it reflects extremely poorly on our company. We are a small business, it’s hard enough out here.

For anyone who thinks it might be user error, I have 22-years IT management experience, I’ve reinstalled, gotten a new phone, contacted tech support (who couldn’t care less to get the issues working), and I’ve also collected diagnostic data from my own device to provide them with the info they were choosing to ignore on their end.

They simply do not care. They used to, but I’ve been dealing with this for a few years now and I’m going to move to some other platform or we’ll just build our own in-house.

So yeah, don’t trust the reviews, feels like they paid a click farm to me. Because if you do a few searches and get beyond the first page of search results (which they currently control through paid advertising), you’ll see there are droves of people and businesses having the same experience as me. 

I don’t mess around writing reviews unless I was extremely impressed or extremely dissatisfied with a product, do congrats FreshBooks, you motivated me.

Very average. Not bad, but wouldn’t recommend.. The mobile app version of FreshBooks has a good interface and is easy to use. However, there are a few issues that have had a significant impact on my billing in a negative way. The main one is Time Entry. In the desktop version of FreshBooks you can toggle between billable and un billable hours. You can also set up retainers that default to to ‘unbillable’ since they’re at a set monthly rate. 

However, the mobile app automatically records EVERYTHING as billable - even if the client is in retainer. This has led to three awkward instances in my part where time has been billed to clients that shouldn’t have. 

It’s a decent app, but also has a decent amount of friction for the end user. You’ll need to put in manual time to ensure tracked time and expenses recorded via mobile device are accurate.

Crashes, Bugs, Sync issues. I went with FreshBooks for my small business because it seemed affordable, and user friendly. The software works, barely, and that’s the only nice thing I can say about it.

The affordability of this software is a bit overstated. In my field I write many quotes, and have different customers day to day. That met that I hit the customer cap in my first month. I wrote quotes to 50 separate people, but only worked for and billed about 15 of those, however the customers saved in the software count against your cap no matter if they’re paying customers or just window shoppers. The plan that gets you unlimited customers is cost competitive with quick books, and other more established or specialized software. It is however marketed as the more comprehensive and cost effective solution.

I use the iOS app and iPad app for most all of my quotes and invoices. The user interface is fine on the surface, but if you try to get any work done with it, you quickly run into issues. I’ve had it randomly log out with no account changes or known issues with my log in. I’ve had it crash while in the middle of a large quote, and loss of all progress, including customer details. I’ve finished a quote and it crashed when I pushed save. I’ve updated an invoice, and it not reflect the changes for hours. I know the best practice of saving often, but if I do, it kicks me completely out of the quote after saving. I’ve sent quotes and invoices multiple times because it didn’t say it sent, but it did.

The most important part of this software is getting paid, however, many of my customers have complained about the difficulty of making payments on the secure portal provided by FreshBooks. FreshBooks also has very little ability to accept partial payment beyond a deposit or structured payment plan. When payment is received, it doesn’t always reflect on the invoice as paid.

This app actively disrupts my workflow for quotes, invoices, billing, and payment. I’m currently looking to switch to another accounting / billing software as I no longer trust that these issues will be resolved after 6 months of waiting.
